shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rounded-top upright slab/stela form
symbolic signs incised on the surface
headdress or head covering on a figure
justification: Both are rounded-top upright monuments bearing low-relief human-related imagery with incised signs and at least one disc-like circular motif, but that is about as generic as monumental relief gets. A shows a multi-figure narrative scene in strict profile with figures seated and kneeling amid columns of small script-like signs, while B is a single frontal, massive block-like figure whose body itself is the carving, with signs spread over torso and head — different scene types, different figural conventions and no shared specific relationships.
